svg.title: 3-layer Terraform module stack
svg.desc: Composition root modules call infrastructure modules, which call resource modules. Orange arrows show module outputs wired into other modules' inputs.

text.tspan: How the composition, infrastructure and resource layers are stacked, and how module outputs are wired between them
backend "s3" {} · terraform init -backend-config=backend.config · aws >= 6.33 · kubernetes ~> 3.0 · helm ~> 3.1 · http ~> 3.5
↻ own output security_group_alb_id is fed back
Environment + region specific root modules. Own the state, read terraform.tfvars, compute locals, wire modules together.
Opinionated building blocks. Apply naming, tags and policies, then call one or more resource modules.
Thin, generic wrappers around raw aws_* / kubernetes_* resources. No knowledge of the environment.
All modules are toggled with create_* flags; resource modules use count / for_each so a disabled module creates nothing.
